title: Edit and metadata sidecars (.rrdata, .rrexif, XMP) are saved atomically, so a crash, power loss or full disk can't leave a half-written edit
highlight: **Your edits are safer.** Edits are saved crash-safe, a damaged mask no longer wipes out the others, and a corrupt panel layout no longer resets your settings.
